# alkira_connector_azure_vhub (Data Source)

Use this data source to get an existing Azure VHUB connector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "alkira_connector_azure_vhub" "test" {
  name = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the connector.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `implicit_group_id` (Number) The implicit group associated with the connector.
